notes.title: Penultimate update
notes.notes:
There is an update that spends the game from early access. The reason for leaving early access is the small popularity of the game.

Added:
Music (currently 10 music tracks, but a little later they will increase to 25)
Maps: Freedom, Neon, Cave
Optimization map "Industrial"

notes.title: New map now available.
notes.notes: Now a new update is being prepared, which will include three more cards, and music will also be added. Feel free to report errors that you encounter.

notes.title: A new map is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Very soon, an update will be available that includes a beautiful map, which you can see below.
If you want the game to be translated into your language, create a topic in the discussion. The new update will include support in the following languages:
-Русский
-Suomen kieli
-Svenska
-Français
-Deutsche
-简体中文
-Čeština
-日本語
